versions.changelog:
Border Collie virtual pet skill updated with revised gameplay and care instructions.

- Updated skill and description for clarity and multilingual support ("Dog. 边牧。Border Collie.").
- Changed emoji from 🐕 to 🐕‍🦺 for clearer Border Collie representation.
- Expanded and clarified care instructions, emphasizing the work mechanic, discipline, and task assignment over play.
- Added item support and examples for all care actions.
- Detailed the penalty and bonus system for early, on-time, and late feedings.
- Improved status response examples to include new fields (e.g., death_clock, milestones, evolution hints).
- Refined and expanded strategy tips specific to Border Collie care and automation.

Initial release of "Adopt a Border Collie" virtual pet skill.

- Adopt a pixel art Border Collie whose happiness depends on being assigned tasks, not play.
- Requires feeding every 3 hours; features trust, discipline, and health stats with real-time decay.
- Includes care actions such as feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflect.
- Border Collie evolves through five stages, with care consistency affecting its growth and outcomes; permanent death and graveyard system.
- Integrates with animalhouse.ai API and provides detailed care automation and API usage examples.
